scope: Current source binding navigation and explicitly scoped authority dispositions. Includes current approval, exact effect/HTTP, audit, Browser policy/profile dispositions and shared System-human privacy validation, alongside earlier lifecycle retirements. Binding alone is not reachability, authorization, runtime or proposal acceptance. Tests are excluded.

analysisLimits.note: All nine CS8795 diagnostics are missing generated-regex implementations in this read-only analysis. The actual solution build passes. Call sites include method references, conditional access, default bodies and concrete implementations. Reflection/dynamic reachability is not established.
analysisLimits.symbolDisplay: Enclosing type/member before the parameter list; exact source file/line disambiguates caller overloads. Method IDs retain full declared contract parameter types.

identity-iam.enforcement: Global Account/authentication and explicit System scope are separate from tenant membership. Current principal, owning resource, scope/role validity, last-owner protections, revision and audit are checked by the current service/store transaction.

definitions.enforcement: TenantAgentDefinitions is the mutable ownership root. Drafts/publications/resources/evaluation join the actual root; exact child/source reads and independent mutation/publish/evaluate permissions precede I/O and commit. Approved immutable built-ins are read-only sources. Global authoring actors are retired.

agent-configuration.enforcement: SystemIdentity binds the actual tenant/Instance/executor. Parent and child IAM, source reads, current revisions, Definition maxima, sparse overrides, freeze and pinned Run policy remain independent. Retained Harness history is inert hash-bound data, not consent authority.

session-runtime.enforcement: TenantSessions joins physical Session/Instance/executor. Current human login/membership/chat/read/manage permissions and trusted claimed Runtime frames fence reads/admission/input/foreground/receipts/voice. One mailbox owns live state. Raw global Session/Profile actors and factory fallback are retired.

approval-operation.enforcement: Actual saved Run preparation binds exact tenant/executor/arguments/source and current primary/secondary authority. Review and eligible ExceptionalGrant are distinct. Decision CAS, fresh human qualification, root dedupe, grant validity and receipt/dispatch fences constrain continuation; unknown effects are not replayed.

automation-event.enforcement: Actual tenant/executor owns Automation, trigger, occurrence and event rows. Human or no-human source attribution, accepted lineage, source/destination authority, semantic intent, current claims and atomic dedupe are explicit. Worker enumeration supplies no ambient human or default tenant.

credential-account.owner: TenantCredentialService; TenantCredentialBindingService; TenantCredentialOAuthService; TenantConnectedAccountReader; TenantAccountRuntimeReadService; TenantAccountEffectService
credential-account.enforcement: TenantCredentials owns physical protected credentials and account profiles; binding also fixes tenant/Instance/executor. Purpose, live scopes/binding epoch/current identity/source reads, exact compound consent and secret maintenance/dispatch receipts fence access. OAuth binds original login, tenant, purpose and nonce. Raw global adapters exclude owned rows.

profile-memory-experience.owner: TenantUserProfileService; TenantRunProfileService; TenantMemoryService; TenantMemoryManagementService; TenantContinuityReadService; TenantExperienceOperationService
profile-memory-experience.enforcement: Actual tenant/User/Account and Agent/source ownership controls independent current reads/manage. Per-Run pin/opt-in/isolation can narrow sources. Learning/forget/consolidation/review use their own exact operation rules. Historical global state tables are not canonical tenant source fallbacks.

files-artifacts.owner: TenantWorkspaceReadService; TenantWorkspaceMutationService; TenantArtifactService; TenantAttachmentService; typed source/publication/cleanup owners
files-artifacts.enforcement: Actual tenant/Instance/Session resolves canonical roots and source bindings. Read/manage/publish/recipient authority remains separate; current witnesses surround byte I/O. Physical content/digest keys grant no access. Cleanup requires exact saved ownership/reference/lifetime proof, not absence from an unowned lookup.

sandbox.enforcement: Actual owned profile/image and verified setup precede claimed Session environment/lease/generation/process/workspace dispatch. Human reset/Stop and model command/read/consent are separate owners. Cleanup preserves uncertainty and requires reference/quiescence proof; external shell identity is a coarse privileged capability.

browser.owner: TenantBrowserEffectService; TenantBrowserReadService; TenantBrowserRetirementService; TenantBrowserProfileService; SystemBrowserPrivacyService; NativePlaywrightBrowser
browser.enforcement: Actual tenant/Agent/Session/executor/profile/handle ownership and current claim, target/origin, binding/read/consent proofs fence native use. Persistent directories are tenant/Agent partitioned. Privacy administration and explicit human profile reset grant no model effect authority. Coordinate/geolocation are unavailable in the tenant adapter.

audit.enforcement: Current human tenant/security.audit.read or explicit aggregate System authority selects authorized audit facts. Global Admin history remains historical data; it is not the tenant audit API. Logs/metrics cannot confer private access or carry protected payloads.

cleanup-isolation.owner: TenantAgentDecommissionService; TenantAgentDecommissionCleanup; TenantRequestIsolationService; tenant file/Browser retirement owners
cleanup-isolation.enforcement: Exact original-human or trusted cleanup proof, current source/security revisions, causal-child accounting and host quiescence constrain logical deletion and physical retirement. Cleanup cannot adopt foreign resources or call absence in an unowned store abandonment.

raw-session-template.owner: Canonical tenant Runtime adapters; immutable approved built-in templates; retained physical store primitives
raw-session-template.enforcement: IMemoryStore is physical storage behind the canonical tenant adapter, not a public authorizer. Canonical Runtime source is tenant-bound. IBuiltInAgentDefinitionStore is approved read-only shared configuration. Unowned snapshots/Profile/test primitives cannot admit a current tenant Run or become a private fallback.

public-http.enforcement: Public research/downloads use bounded network/DNS/redirect/content policies and current task/source controls. General public HTTP mutation additionally requires the exact current operation/consent and durable dispatch/receipt boundary; no bound private account or raw provider fallback.

immutable-builtins.disposition: Immutable approved read-only configuration. All Get/List receivers are IBuiltInAgentDefinitionStore, including nullable receivers; no tenant/unowned composite fallback. The empty child interface inherits the two parent slots.

runtime-storage-bridge.disposition: Canonical factory injects TenantRuntimeMemoryStore over an actual tenant Runtime frame. Load/save/history check exact Session and delegate to current claimed tenant storage. Profile/global recovery reject on that adapter. Canonical snapshots have no ProfileId. Physical raw store methods exclude owned Sessions; startup recovery only processes unowned Sessions/Runs. Remaining uncalled inventories and Profile rows are native data mechanisms, not an API or tenant fallback.

raw-attachment-data.disposition: All raw Session attachment entry points use RequireUnowned; expiry excludes TenantId rows. Owned factory does not inject raw attachments/processor/capability loader into Runtime. TenantAttachmentRuntimeContextService uses current tenant source/read/consent fences and ProcessSourceAsync. Retained native Runtime/processor fixtures use raw methods; ID/cache possession is not tenant read authority.

raw-instance-data.disposition: Raw inventory/find omit owned Instances; public native revision/Skill/Resource writes reject owned IDs. Insert is physical creation within the canonical owner transaction or retained native fixtures; duplicate IDs cannot adopt an owned row. HasBackingInstance is only an existence fence for deletion, not a private read. Uncalled native mutation/history/child slots remain data contracts with no private route/model caller. The unused unscoped isolation writer is removed rather than retained as another mutation authority.

owned-agent-configuration.disposition: Reads join actual tenant SystemIdentity and Instance, filter allowed IDs before paging/count and expose metadata only through current service IAM. Trusted service proposals carry actor/current security witness; actual API writes carry original human reference. Store locks/transactions repeat ownership/active actor/security and Instance/child/source revisions, audit/reference validity and supplied original-human checks. Model local/approved effects use their separate exact typed transaction, not a human/session shortcut.

owned-management-sources-effects.disposition: Saved owned Run/root/executor, optional exact live generation for execution, current requester/source/raw reads and immutable/current management policy fence observations and retention. Human inspection is a current scoped read, not model effect authority. Retained pin uses exact same-task completed receipts and source witnesses. Skill/Resource/binding reads retain independent raw/Review gates. Direct commits repeat primary/secondary authority, exact operation/arguments, Run generation/security revision, same-root suppression, source bytes and atomic receipt/audit/configuration.

exact-decommission.disposition: Original current human read/delete and exact owner/security/Instance/references precede irreversible retirement. Same transaction rechecks current human and underlying scope; immutable receipt provides bounded idempotence. Worker enumeration is only a saved technical owner proof. Native profile/workspace cleanup repeats exact retired tenant/Instance/executor proof and refuses live/uncertain mounts; no absence-in-raw-store abandonment.

exact-request-isolation.disposition: Actual exact Session root, pinned strict request policy, bounded complete Run/child/receipt graph and exact lease constrain settlement. Existing canonical host requires quiescent reservation and no live/voice owner. Native retirement repeats readiness/revision proof; final transaction repeats complete graph and terminated lease. Worker pagination cannot select another tenant or mint execution authority.

raw-credential-binding-data.disposition: Physical raw Credential inventory/get/rotation and writes exclude every owned or retired owner marker. Raw binding inventory excludes owned Instances/Credentials before projection; association writes and bulk cleanup reject owned targets under the Instance lock/SQLite transaction. Current raw Get/ListBindings callers belong only to the retained unowned EmailWatch data mechanism, whose claim scan excludes tenant rows; they cannot resolve owned protected values. Tenant runtime secret-use paths resolve through their separate actual owner/effect contracts.

owned-credential-human-lifecycle.disposition: Current Credential metadata needs scoped read; CRUD needs exact independent manage/read and logical/secret/security witnesses. Owned queries filter actual tenant before totals. Binding requires actual tenant Instance/Credential, parent read/update, exact item read/bind, active lifecycle/current Agent Connections policy and source/Instance/binding revisions. Every current human HTTP handler derives Account/session/principal server-side; service reads revalidate that original live human after I/O and the same security revision. Credential and binding write transactions recheck exact original human alongside actor/security/owner witnesses before mutation (and SQLite before commit); no effect, source, grant or plaintext authority follows from a binding or metadata ID. Trusted internal principal commands remain independently scoped; model consent/effects use their existing exact typed owners.

raw-definition-data.disposition: All native root/draft/publication/resource/evaluation reads exclude tenant-owned and retired owner markers, through explicit InMemory owner checks or SQLite global query filters joining the real root. Native changes reject or cannot select owned targets; create checks ownership inside its transaction. No private HTTP authoring service calls these ports. Retained exact-source/native publication readers cannot resolve owned durable definitions; canonical owned Run configuration pins independently eligible resource bindings and uses current source authority. Uncalled authoring/evaluation slots remain native data/test contracts, not a second tenant authoring authority.

owned-definition-lifecycle.disposition: All nineteen canonical slots resolve actual tenant roots; allowed inventory IDs filter before totals. Services independently enforce Definition and resource-child read/mutation/destination authority. Eleven owning mutation slots repeat security/actor/owner and exact draft/source/publication/evaluation/deletion witnesses inside the shared lock/transaction. Current HTTP authoring and byte/metadata reads derive original Account/session/principal server-side; mutations carry that reference into the owning transaction, and reads revalidate the original human and unchanged security revision after private I/O. Offline evaluation repeats the human witness before computation and the result transaction; it creates no provider effect. Other canonical publication consumers retain their own current owned Run/Instance/source/receipt fences. Internal principal commands retain scoped IAM; no synthetic human is required for autonomy.

physical-definition-content.disposition: Two physical immutable hash/byte methods confer no tenant ownership or read grant. Writes verify content, bounded paths and immutable collision identity; reads verify hash. Canonical Definition/Instance human byte delivery uses the independent no-follow verified-source facet and current exact binding/source authority; retained pinned/inspection reads verify hash/size under their separate current typed source fences. The raw hash reader itself is not a no-follow or authorization primitive. Every bound caller is a native excluded-row reader, approved built-in preparation, independently fenced owned resource/configuration projection, or staging for the existing typed transaction. Refused staging may leave unreferenced immutable bytes; it cannot create a tenant binding, revision or audit. No HTTP hash-only binding is accepted.

identity-security-owners.disposition: Sixteen trusted identity/security data slots are not private read grants. FindAccount is used by password verification; native bootstrap is one-use globally and registration creates no role or membership. Session validation checks current Account status/stamp, revocation and expiry. Tenant/System aggregate reads feed current authorizers and owning transactions, not direct serialized private roots. Membership inventory filters actual active Account-linked users/tenants; HTTP Account views repeat the original Account/session/Principal after I/O. Tenant security writes freeze the aggregate, retain immutable Agent identity, exact current revision, current actors (including both inviter and invitee for acceptance), active-owner and real resource references. Every current human member/role/assignment HTTP mutation supplies its original tenant reference to the actual transaction. Authenticated invitation acceptance supplies the existing Account Principal before membership exists; no tenant identity is invented. Password changes keep password reauthentication, security-stamp CAS and original-login validation inside the owner. Unauthenticated registration retains its exact invitation-proof path; trusted principal-only native fixtures remain scoped and are not an HTTP fallback. The uncalled raw audit reader remains a bounded native data query. The unused global AccountAdministrationService and DI registration are removed from production; its unchanged helper exists only in native tests.

system-human-administration.disposition: System catalog reads expose paged safe metadata only after actual current system permission and original Account/session/Principal checks, repeated after I/O. All four mutation operations across administration and operator ownership require the original human, exact current raw system permission and applicable target revision/stamp or new-root uniqueness, audit identity and active final-Owner/operator constraints in the owning lock/transaction. Operator membership changes rotate the target Account stamp. Scope is actual System; platform grants do not imply private tenant access. Shared Account/session identity validation is extracted unchanged from the incumbent System helper and reused by authenticated Account acceptance/password owners; the independent System permission check remains mandatory.

durable-approval-lifecycle.disposition: Ten lifecycle slots. Reads resolve actual tenant/request/root/executor; semantic root fingerprint is separate from exact action hash. Human inventory computes independent primary/source visibility before count/paging and repeats the original human/security witness after metadata and review I/O. Conversation-only projection is minimal factual status under current owning conversation authority. Creation checks actual owned Run/generation/lease, executor/requester, exact typed source witnesses, expiry, current security and independent storm bounds in one transaction. Decision repeats original human, current primary/underlying permission, independence, immutable exact action/revisions and grant/signal shapes. Expiry/resume use exact persisted tenant/Run/request/revision/signal, consume once and admit only the incumbent bounded continuation; worker scans are not execution authority.

exact-approved-effect-common.disposition: Seven receipt/local-effect/Browser-dispatch slots. Every read is tenant-qualified; direct receipt also binds actual Run/source-call and parameter hash. Owning local commit resolves saved request/decision/optional exact grant, actual same-tenant claimed Run/continuation and target, current security/actor/policy and typed source witnesses before applying effect plus receipt/audit/Run/grant together. Repeated receipt must match complete exact identity, never bless changed arguments. Browser reserves one durable dispatch, repeats current authority at the native gate and settles only the exact saved fence. Recovery seals eligible abandoned reservations as indeterminate and never replays native IO. Factual settlement is distinct from current permission to disclose observations. Typed family source/effect owners retain their independent review queues; this is the common transaction disposition, not every positive family effect.

current-tenant-operation-policy.disposition: One existing policy transaction. Human read/manage requires original current tenant User and independent governance permission; reads repeat human/security after I/O. Save uses security/policy CAS and cannot weaken immutable Core approval floors. Both owning stores repeat original human plus active actor/current security and valid references before saving policy/security/audit atomically. Executor IAM is independent of requester review policy; no synthetic human or blanket sensitive review is added to already-authorized autonomy.

native-admin-history-data.disposition: Three retained native historical-data methods. Append validates bounded typed/redacted summaries and deduplicates immutable operation IDs; lookup supports guarded native backing transactions. Unscoped List has no production caller and is a bounded retained contract/test query, not tenant audit or an authority grant. Current private activity/audit uses its owning tenant projection; old Admin HTTP/service mutation/read roots remain retired. No application/HTTP caller or reflective store dispatch exposes these native events as private tenant access.

owned-audit-facts.disposition: Three canonical query/record slots. Tenant/System query filters actual owner and closed System-safe facts before totals/paging; Application repeats original human and current raw audit permission after I/O, with same tenant revision for private reads. Workspace records require actual owned Workspace/Instance/Session, original human, exact revisions and recomputed read/write decision. Model records require current exact owned Run/context/revision/generation and validated bounded catalog/scope classifications. Audit records are immutable facts, never grants or executable receipts; denied/unsupported attempts do not copy attacker arguments or unknown permission text.

system-browser-privacy.disposition: Two policy data/owning mutation slots. Raw read supplies saved immutable host policy to the canonical Browser policy service and grants no private inspection or mutation. System view/save requires original global Account/session/Principal and independent system.governance.manage. Shared System-human guard now supplies the same live identity/permission checks inside both owning stores; separate audit shape, policy CAS, deployment mode/origin ceilings and effective-versus-saved restart semantics remain. No tenant role implies this System permission.

exact-tenant-browser-profile.disposition: Two profile-reset transaction slots. Start proves actual tenant/Instance/executor, active lifecycle, original human and independent Agent/Browser read/manage, exact security/Instance/native witness/epoch and unique operation/audit. Canonical native control checks authorization before start and again before deletion. Settlement records only the exact pending saved owner/operation and cannot initiate close/delete; read-time recovery records cached or unknown facts without native replay. Human view repeats original login and same security/Instance witnesses after native I/O. Later logout/cancellation cannot erase a started operation fact or authorize another reset.

exact-public-http-dispatch.disposition: Three typed HTTP effect slots. Start resolves actual tenant request/decision/exact optional grant, owned same-root claimed Run/continuation, current target/source/raw authority, expiry and root suppression before one durable reservation. The service repeats current authority through provider dispatch callbacks, bounded by claim/consent/tool/overall deadlines. Settlement matches the complete exact saved fence and atomically records Run/receipt/grant/audit; private result body retention requires fresh source authority. Recoverable enumeration selects only actual same-owner abandoned/in-flight reservations without a receipt; recovery seals indeterminate and never calls the transport again. This is the owner transaction disposition; physical network address/redirect/size controls retain their separate transport evidence.
